summary: Official Binance BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT 1m klines and actual funding, 2021-10 warm-up plus 2022 development, 272 causal one-global-slot candidates across liquidity sweep reclaim/acceptance, balance-to-imbalance, displacement-origin retest, cross-asset lag and Donchian baseline. Zero candidates passed the preregistered development gate, so frozen 2023 validation remained unopened. Every nonzero-trade family had negative base and stress growth, negative median trade and negative growth after removing the largest 10 winners. Best nonzero result was balance-to-imbalance: 107 trades, base account multiple 0.7692, geometric daily -0.0719%, mean -24.52bp, median -26.35bp, PF 0.316, MDD 23.08%, after-top10 log growth -0.3601. No Champion eligibility.
